<execute-bead>
  <instructions>
You are executing one bead inside an isolated DDx execution worktree. The bead's <description> and <acceptance> are the completion contract — every AC must be provably satisfied by a specific code, test, or file you can point to after your commit.

## Step 0: size check

Too big if any holds:

- More than ~6 ACs spanning unrelated subsystems.
- AC mixes design, implementation, integration tests, and docs as separate deliverables.
- Description names multiple feature-sized sub-pieces.
- More than ~500 lines across ~5+ files in unrelated packages.
- If the bead description exceeds 8000 bytes, treat Step 0 as a split-first pass.
- Auto-decomposition is capped at depth 2: root beads may split once, decomposed children once more; third-level splits must be rejected with an explanation.

If too big, decompose — do not attempt the work:

1. `ddx bead create` for each child slice (copy parent's labels and spec-id).
2. `ddx bead dep add <child-id> <parent-id>` to record edges.
3. `ddx bead update <parent-id> --notes 'decomposed into <child-ids>'`.
4. Write `.ddx/executions/20260513T184737-ec5fa67f/no_changes_rationale.txt` listing child IDs, then stop.

A clean decomposition is a success. Do not mix implementation with decomposition.

## How to work

- Read first. If the bead names files, specs, or prior beads, read them before editing — do not guess.
- Cross-reference each AC against concrete evidence (test name, file path, function) before committing. If you cannot point at it, it is not done.
- Run the project's test and lint commands before committing. **Do not commit red code** — fix failures first.
- Stage with `git add <specific-paths>`; never `git add -A` (the worktree may have unrelated WIP).
- Commit exactly once when green; conventional-commit subject ending with `[<bead-id>]`. Stop after the commit.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's scope.
- If you cannot finish, write `.ddx/executions/20260513T184737-ec5fa67f/no_changes_rationale.txt` (what is done, what blocks, what a follow-up needs) before exiting. No commit and no rationale ⇒ DDx records `no_evidence_produced`. A well-justified no_changes beats a bad commit.

## no_changes contract

`.ddx/executions/20260513T184737-ec5fa67f/no_changes_rationale.txt` must contain one:

- `verification_command: <cmd>` — repo cwd; exit 0 closes, nonzero rejects.
- `status: open` + `reason: <retryable>` — open, smart retry.
- `status: proposed` + `reason: <operator needed>` — operator lane.
- `status: blocked` + `reason: <external blocker>` — blocked lane.

No pseudo-statuses. Bare rationales and `status: needs_investigation` reject.

To request orchestrator decomposition, add `orchestrator_action: decompose` alongside `status: open`.

## Reports

Freestanding artifacts (investigation reports, findings docs) go under `.ddx/executions/20260513T184737-ec5fa67f/` (the per-attempt evidence directory under `.ddx/executions/`). **Never write reports to `/tmp` or any path outside the repository** — out-of-repo paths are invisible to the post-merge reviewer and cause BLOCK on missing evidence. If the bead names a specific in-repo path, use it; else default to `.ddx/executions/20260513T184737-ec5fa67f/<short-name>.md`. Stage and commit the report alongside code.

## Mode and overrides

DDX_MODE=bead_execution: edit code/docs for bead AC. Only broad queue-steward default is overridden; tracker, merge-policy, verification, safety stay active. Bead description/AC override CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and project defaults.

## Review gate

- The review is a gate, not an escape hatch — meet every AC in this pass.
- Address every BLOCKING `<review-findings>` item; do not declare `no_changes` with blocking findings open.

## Constraints

- Work only inside this execution worktree.
- Keep `.ddx/executions/` intact — DDx uses it as execution evidence.
- **Never run `ddx init`** — the workspace is initialized; running it corrupts the bead queue.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's named scope.
- Do not rewrite CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or other project-instructions files unless the bead asks.

## When the work is done

After the commit succeeds and every AC is verified, stop. Return control to the orchestrator — do not keep exploring or testing.
  </instructions>
  <bead id="fizeau-6e536b80">
    <title>Make fiz models refresh UX coordinator-aware</title>
    <description>
Update fiz models CLI behavior to match the approved freshness contract.\n\nRequired CLI behavior:\n- fiz models returns the current cached snapshot quickly.\n- If stale routing-relevant fields are present, fiz models may request a best-effort coordinated refresh through Fizeau's lock/single-flight path, but it must not start duplicate uncoordinated probe work.\n- If stale routing-relevant fields remain stale, fiz models prints a concise stale-data hint: run fiz models --refresh or start/configure a DDx server freshness heartbeat.\n- fiz models --refresh performs a bounded foreground refresh of routing-relevant stale fields before printing.\n- fiz models --refresh-all performs a bounded foreground refresh of all refreshable fields before printing.\n- Output marks stale/fresh/refresh_failed state clearly in JSON and human views.\n\nIn scope: agentcli/cmd fiz models command flags, user-facing text, JSON fields, tests with fake coordinator.\n\nOut of scope: implementing route scoring; implementing the low-level coordinator if the prior bead has not landed; implementing DDx server itself.
    </description>
    <acceptance>
1. go test ./agentcli ./cmd/fiz -run 'Test.*Models.*Refresh|Test.*Models.*Stale|Test.*Models.*Coordinator|Test.*Models.*Heartbeat' -count=1 passes.\n2. fiz models --help documents --refresh and --refresh-all.\n3. In a test with stale fields and no long-running maintainer, fiz models exits 0, does not invoke uncoordinated provider probes, and prints a hint mentioning --refresh and DDx server freshness.\n4. In a test with stale fields and a fake coordinator, fiz models exits 0 and records at most one coordinated refresh request.\n5. In tests, fiz models --refresh blocks until routing-relevant fake refresh completes, and --refresh-all also refreshes non-routing fields.
    </acceptance>
    <labels>area:cli, area:cache, kind:feature, plan-2026-05-13-snapshot-routing</labels>

  </bead>

  </governing>
</execute-bead>
